From d7228a58d9438d6f219dc7f33eab0d1980b3bd2f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Benjamin Gray <bgray@linux.ibm.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2024 21:23:17 +1000
Subject: [PATCH] selftests/powerpc/dexcr: Add -no-pie to hashchk tests

The hashchk tests want to verify that the hash key is changed over exec.
It does so by calculating hashes at the same address across an exec.
This is made simpler by disabling PIE functionality, so we can
re-execute ourselves and be using the same addresses in the child.

While -fno-pie is already added, -no-pie is also required.

Fixes: bdb07f35a52f ("selftests/powerpc/dexcr: Add hashst/hashchk test")
Signed-off-by: Benjamin Gray <bgray@linux.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>
Link: https://msgid.link/20240417112325.728010-2-bgray@linux.ibm.com

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile b/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile
index 523947a38d17..1b775959f981 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ TEST_GEN_FILES := lsdexcr
 include ../../lib.mk
 include ../flags.mk
 
-$(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
+$(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie -no-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
 
 $(TEST_GEN_PROGS): ../harness.c ../utils.c ./dexcr.c
 $(TEST_GEN_FILES): ../utils.c ./dexcr.c
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `tools/testing/selftests/powerpc/dexcr/Makefile`**
   - The line that sets the `CFLAGS` for the `hashchk_test` target has been modified to include an additional flag:
     - Changed from:
       ```make
       $(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
       ```
     - To:
       ```make
       $(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie -no-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
       ```

### Relationships

- The modification in the `Makefile` adds the `-no-pie` flag to the compilation of the `hashchk_test`, which is intended to ensure that the test can verify the hash key changes over an `exec` by maintaining the same memory addresses. This change complements the existing `-fno-pie` flag, enhancing the test's ability to function correctly by disabling Position Independent Executable (PIE) functionality. The patch addresses a specific issue related to the hashchk tests, as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit.

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the hashchk tests' requirement to verify that the hash key changes upon execution. This verification is complicated by the use of Position Independent Executables (PIE), which can lead to different memory addresses being used across executions. The absence of the `-no-pie` flag prevents the tests from consistently using the same addresses, thereby hindering the ability to accurately assess the hash key changes.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```makefile

```
Reason:
The use of `-fno-pie` alone does not prevent the generation of Position Independent Executables (PIE), which can result in different memory addresses being used across executions. This inconsistency complicates the verification of hash key changes, as the tests cannot reliably execute at the same address.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```makefile
$(OUTPUT)/hashchk_test: CFLAGS += -fno-pie -no-pie $(call cc-option,-mno-rop-protect)
```
Reason:
Adding the `-no-pie` flag ensures that the executable is not position-independent, allowing the hashchk tests to consistently use the same memory addresses across executions. This consistency is crucial for accurately verifying that the hash key changes as expected upon execution.
